Package com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders

Class DiscoverResultBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders.DiscoverResultBuilder
public class DiscoverResultBuilder extends Object
Builder for creating DiscoverResult objects with a fluent API.

This replaces InitializeResultBuilder. Because server/discover is answered by a throwaway probe process on stdio, everything here is derived from static configuration.

Example usage:


 DiscoverResult result = DiscoverResultBuilder.builder()
     .withDefaultCapabilities()
     .withTasksExtension()
     .withDefaultServerInfo()
     .build();
Since:
1.0

    • withExtension

      public DiscoverResultBuilder withExtension(String identifier, Object config)
      Declares support for an MCP extension under capabilities.extensions.

      Extensions use the format {vendor-prefix}/{extension-name}; official ones use the io.modelcontextprotocol prefix. An empty configuration object is the conventional way to say "supported, no settings".

      Parameters:
      identifier - the extension identifier, e.g. MetaKeys.TASKS_EXTENSION
      config - the configuration object for this extension
      Returns:
      this builder instance for method chaining

    • withDefaultCapabilities

      public DiscoverResultBuilder withDefaultCapabilities()
      Sets default server capabilities for this workshop server.

      listChanged is deliberately left unset on tools and prompts. A client that sees listChanged: true opens a subscriptions/listen stream, and this server only advertises that once it can acknowledge the stream correctly.

      Returns:
      this builder instance for method chaining

    • build

      public DiscoverResult build()
      Builds and returns the final DiscoverResult.

      Capabilities configured through withExtension(java.lang.String, java.lang.Object) or withExperimentalCapability(java.lang.String, java.lang.Object) after withDefaultCapabilities() are folded in here, so declaration order in the calling chain does not matter.

      Returns:
      a new DiscoverResult with the configured properties
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if capabilities or server info are not set
